summary: Medicure Inc. filed a Form 6-K reporting the results of its Annual General Meeting held May 21, 2026. Shareholders approved setting the board at five directors, elected all nominees including a new independent director, and reappointed auditors. A non-routine director departure (Peter Quick stepping down) is disclosed, but this change appears voluntary after twenty years of service, not forced or abrupt, and is part of the normal AGM cycle. No special situation transaction or catalyst exists in this filing.
